flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati with no saved data (clear this site's browser storage and reload if any bills or people exist).
Add the people Ana, Ben and Cy.
Add a bill named Rent with amount 900.00, paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.

Add a bill named Electricity with amount 300.00, paid by Ben, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy.
Delete the Electricity bill.
Open Settle up and read the payment lines.
Assert Settle up shows "Ben pays Ana 300.00".
Assert The Electricity bill is no longer listed.
Store The payment line shown for Ben in Settle up as 'settle_line'.
